rows.en: You can get through, you know.
That drill I mentioned? I've installed it on the "Ride Machine."
Hikari...!
Impressive as ever.
As an engineer, I only did what was expected of me.
Well? What are you standing around for? Get going!!
The Ride Machine's drill was replaced with the Permidar Drill.
An Item Search function was added to the Ride Machine.
And one more thing: I've also added an "Item Search" function.
What's that...?
In "Ride Dungeons," it reacts when you get near an item and lets you know... or it should, anyway.
Oh, it's nothing much. I just adapted the technology from the Denden Sensor.
I see... Truly fascinating.
It's a message calling for rescue, and it seems to have been sent from the next Cube.
Obtained Kamen Rider 2's chip.
Obtained Ultraman Ace's chip.
Obtained Ultraman Jack's chip.
Obtained Zoffy's chip.
The "Gaia Impact," huh...
In our original world, as I recall... the plan is to drain the "Earth's memories" from the Gaia Gate,
leave only those compatible with "Gaia Memories," and wipe out everyone else.
...Then carrying out that plan would require a Gaia Gate, wouldn't it?
Of course. Without the Gaia Gate, there is no plan.
From what I heard from the enemy, there's something like a well underground.
What!?
Most likely, that's the Gaia Gate.
Underground, huh... So there's even more below those ruins?
That's what I believe, yes.
Then why don't we just hurry up and go check it out?
After resting in the medical room, Taro soon recovered.
Then he began to share what he had learned while he was frozen.
...Yes. Even while I was frozen, my five senses were still working.
Then have you picked up any information about the enemy?
...Only in fragments, but I did overhear some things.
Somewhere, there is another Cube...
It seems all kinds of "power" are kept there: kaiju, kaijin and weapons researched in each Cube.
The enemy said as much. That they're stealing items and sending them to the next Cube...
Yeah. Maybe we can take back my "Xtreme Memory" and the rest of the "power" we lost.
It'd be great if the Core Medals are there too.
Well, yeah.
Either way, though, we must first find that Cube...
In that case, let me access "Veda" and search for it.
Veda?
It's a quantum computer that holds all the information of the world I came from.
Veda is in this world!?
Yes. It seems it was pulled in too. I don't know where it is, but...
I can access it.
With that, Seravee quietly closed his eyes.
What's going on?
Seravee is an "Innovator."
So it isn't something you operate by hand...
Right.
Found it...! It's not complete, but the information we need is there.
Oh...
First, the Ride Gate... It's in the room at the back of the Plasma Spark Tower.
Go on through the Ride Dungeon from there, and you'll reach the fifth Cube.
But there seem to be a lot of enemies. We'd better be ready for that...
You can tell that much!?
In our original world, "Veda" managed all the information in the entire world.
It seems that here too, it's somehow gathering information and has begun managing it.
We'd be fools not to make use of this.
However, there's almost no data on places under enemy control.
I see... But with this as a foothold, it looks like we can move forward.
Right. First, the Plasma Spark Tower's back room. Then we head for the next Cube via the Ride Gate.
That is all! Good luck!!
An Innovator?
Only Innovators have the right to access Veda.
Right now, Seravee's mind should be connected to Veda.
Also, I can't say for certain, but some big "plan" seems to be in motion.
A plan?
I don't know the details, but they seem set to make some kind of move against our original worlds.
Did you say Veda!?
Yes. It seems they were installing the "Earth's memories" into Veda.
There were no signs of anything like that...
Can you access it?
I'll try...
What's wrong!?

notes.note: 0917 speakers recovered from Command/0917.bla (MessWinSet +N plays entry N-152 in this table): 0.14/0.15/0.18/0.26/0.28/0.29 Hikari, 0.16 Nu Gundam, 0.17/0.32 Zoffy, 0.27/0.30 Philip. Extracted labels were empty. Lines copied from 0359 reuse story_066 English.
Not played by the 0917 script (leftover from the 0359 copy); reused story_066 English, voiced as Hikari.
Zoffy, played straight after 0.1 (the Ultra Sign). 'It' = the Ultra Sign message.
Source names the chip 'Ultraman Zoffy'; glossary has only 'Zoffy', so used that.

0918 copies 0576 #0.93-0.103 with slightly different wording; reused story_102/103 English where identical. One sentence spans 0.2/0.3, cut at the matching point. Speakers verified from 0918.bla (Zoffy/Philip/Accel/Ankh/Birth).
Taro to Zoffy (polite, elder brother); adapted the 0463 English. Play order per 0919.bla: 0.1-0.11, 0.46-0.48, then 0.12-0.21, 0.41-0.44, 0.22-0.37; all extracted labels correct.
Zoffy reacting to Seravee silently closing his eyes, so 'What's going on?' rather than the stock 'What do you mean?'.
Zoffy realising Veda is accessed mentally, not operated by hand; impersonal 'you'.
Plural 'original worlds' inferred (the heroes come from several worlds); 'they' = the enemy.
0920 speakers verified from 0920.bla; Ankh's 0.33 plays between 0.3 and 0.4 (next slice).
